summary: A power failure caused a plant outage at Wacky Wheels Jackson (P_MS) from 2027-03-26 through 2027-03-30. A total of 9 production orders were moved, with 6 rescheduled at the same plant and 3 transferred to P_KY, P_AL, and P_NC because no same-plant slot was free. Additionally, 36 dealers were notified once each regarding 79 customer orders, and 17 loaners were assigned.
decision_reason: The system acted because the incident was confirmed with dates and identifiers resolved against the data, the handbook validators and digital-twin rehearsal passed, and the live schedule baseline matched before the first write. The auditor confirmed that the plant outage was accurately identified and that all rescheduling, dealer notifications, and loaner allocations adhered strictly to policy rules.
